==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Frenzy}}

==Notes==
*Can be effectively used by secondary warriors, since it is the only [[No Attribute skill]] that provides blocking.
*[[Damage reduction]], such as [[Protective Spirit]], will be taken into account after Frenzied Defense, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, consider using a [[cancel stance]].
*Used with [[Spirit Bond]], the attacks that are not blocked are more likely to trigger the healing effect and can effectively negate all incoming damage from attacks.

==Trivia==
